title: console cosmetic and UX observations from the v18.4.0 sweep (6 rows)
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Source: v18.4.0 sweep close-out, #32908 comment 6881136418 (devx#4 ledger, read at `87330e89`), routed by triage.

## Rows
- 99 (#33048 · 6846028996), `access-security.share-link-landing-page`: the header prints the object's API name and field API names, and system fields are listed.
- 118 (#33048), `records-forms.concurrent-edit-conflict`: a conflict on several fields renders raw JSON.
- 147 (#33048), `studio-authoring.authoring-validation-not-persisted` A3: the upper banner runs past the viewport at 1440 px.
- 246 (#33093 · 6850899929), `identity-auth.session-list-revoke`: the revoked view keeps the 'Active user sessions' subtitle and toolbar button.
- 248 (#33093), `identity-auth.api-key-ui-lifecycle`: the row menu offers Edit, but only revoked keys are editable.
- 254, second half (#33096 · 6851700388), `automation.connector-dispatch-matrix`: the picker keeps stale Input rows when the action changes.

## Do
Fix them where they render. Row 254's stale rows can send the wrong inputs, so fix it first.

## Grade
**p3**. Row 254 alone is p2 if it really sends stale inputs. Check it.

## Reader
`domain:ui`.
